description: Measure integrated loudness (LUFS), loudness range (LU), and true peak (dBFS) from a local media file using FFmpeg's EBU R128 filter. Analysis only: it does not normalize audio or change Premiere.

max_true_peak_dbfs.description: Optional maximum acceptable true peak in dBFS (commonly -1 or -2)

media_path.description: Absolute path to a local audio or video file. Provide this or project_item_id.

project_item_id.description: Project item whose local media path should be resolved through Premiere. Provide this or media_path.

target_lufs.description: Optional delivery target in LUFS (for example -14 streaming, -16 podcast, or -23 broadcast)

tolerance_lu.description: Allowed absolute difference from target_lufs (default: 1 LU)

name: analyze_loudness

data.description: Tool-specific result data when ok is true.

error.description: Failure detail when ok is false.

title: Analyze Loudness
